rationale: The discourse has stabilized into a clear technical impasse: all sides now accept the need for restructuring and process, but the core conflict over plant closures, compulsory redundancies, site protection, and burden-sharing remains unresolved. Round 3 added useful validation from the expert, yet it did not unlock new bargaining movement; further rounds are likely to repeat the same positions unless a mediator forces a quantified package comparison and decision framework.
